top_signals.title: Powerful earthquake hits Japan’s southern Kumamoto prefecture
top_signals.summary: Reports of multiple deaths from tremor after blast at shopping centre and damage to factories, buildings and infrastructure
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: TCBY Executive Director on Resurgence of Frozen Yogurt
top_signals.summary: TCBY Executive Director Richard Screnci believes there is a place for consumers to watch their health and enjoy eating sweet treats at the same time, as the company looks for more growth opportunities both domestically and abroad. He speaks to Romaine Bostick and Emily Graffeo on Bloomberg's 'The Close.' (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Databricks Co-Founder: IPO a Matter of "When" Not "If"
top_signals.summary: Databricks Co-Founder and Senior VP of Field Engineering Arsalan Tavakoli sees an endless amount of possibilities in the AI space, but also the need for governance at all levels of the industry as the company waits for the right time to go public. He speaks to Romaine Bostick and Emily Graffeo on Bloomberg's 'The Close.' (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Barnes and Noble CEO: 'The Odyssey' is Our Best-Selling Book
top_signals.summary: Barnes and Noble CEO James Daunt is seeing a tremendous resurgence in the business as consumers return to a love of physical book stores, with more to offer like vinyl records and in-store cafes. He also attributes blockbuster Hollywood successes such as 'The Odyssey' being a driving force for Gen Z and older to read more. He speaks with Romaine Bostick and Emily Graffeo on Bloomberg's 'The Close.' (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Rithm Captial CEO on Real Estate Outlook
top_signals.summary: Rithm Capital Chairman and CEO Michael Nierenberg speaks with Romaine Bostick and Emily Graffeo on Bloomberg's 'The Close' on the company's most recent earnings, as well as looking to the future both in the real estate outlook and overall growth for the company. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Mall collapses after powerful quake rocks Kumamoto
top_signals.summary: The quake registered up to shindo 7, the highest level on the Japanese seismic intensity scale.
